```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Problem 1
```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset contains data on penguin species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year. The dataset includes three penguin species: Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo, which are observed on three islands: Biscoe, Dream, and Torgersen. Also, the dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(data = penguins,
       aes(x = bill_length_mm,
           y = flipper_length_mm,
           color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
ggsave("penguins_scatterplot.png")
```
